summary: Dashboard ranking: ordered list with position badges (top three highlighted), label and description, a decorative proportional bar and a value formatted with Intl.
whenToUse: Showing the top items of a metric (most-read articles, best-selling products, most active authors).
Giving an at-a-glance view of the proportions among the top entries.
whenNotToUse: Data to sort, filter or paginate: use DataTable.
Comparisons across series or over time: use BarChart or LineChart.

props.name: title
props.description: Card title; also provides the list's accessible name.

props.name: items
props.description: Items already in ranking order (the first is #1).

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Shows only the first N items.

props.name: barStyle
props.description: Bar color: one data color per row (--dc-color-data-1…6) or the brand gradient.

props.name: footer
props.description: Link to the full list or a note.

inherits: HTML attributes of <div> (id, style, data-*, aria-*).
accessibility: <ol> list named by the title (aria-labelledby): the position is announced by the list and written in the badge.
Bars are aria-hidden: the value is always formatted text.
Highlighting the top three doesn't rely on color alone: the position number is visible.
In forced-colors mode badges and bars use Canvas/CanvasText/Highlight with a border.
responsive: Long labels wrap; the value stays aligned to the end of the row.
Use Grid with minItemWidth to place multiple rankings side by side.
commonMistakes: Passing unsorted items: the component doesn't reorder, positions follow the array order.
Conveying information through the bar alone: include it in the value or description.
Showing dozens of rows: limit with maxItems and add a link in the footer.

examples.name: Gradient
examples.title: Gradient bars
examples.description: Currency values and a link to the full list.

limits: Bars are proportional to the largest visible absolute value: negative values are shown as positive lengths.
No automatic sorting or row interaction.
